title: First Above
statement: Implement `solve(items, limit)`. Return the first integer strictly greater than `limit`. If none exists, return the string `none`. Stop at the first hit. Later larger values do not matter.
constraints: items is a list of integers
hints: Return the item as soon as it is greater than limit.
If the loop ends, return the string none.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: A generator that yields until a condition fails is takewhile.

editorial: A generator that yields until a condition fails is takewhile. This function is the dual: the first success. Scanning the rest of the list after a hit cannot change the answer and is the bug when the tail is expensive.
